summary: Frontend-only MVP testing for GrowthSquad Research Terminal completed. All 6 pages render, all required data-testids exist and are wired correctly. Navigation, command palette (click + Ctrl+K + Escape), watchlist tabs/filter, all 7 sector buttons, earnings tabs, AI research suggestions/chat/send/reset, stock detail tabs (Financials/Margins/AI Lens) and peer link navigation, brand logo nav, market ticker, and mobile drawer (toggle visible <1024px, sheet opens with 7 nav links) all working. No runtime errors. Only console warnings are Radix accessibility warnings about missing DialogTitle in CommandDialog/Sheet.

issues: Several Key Metrics rows render with em-dash/empty values (Order Book, Book/Bill, Net Cash, EPS FY26E) because mock fundamentals are only complete for HAL. Consider populating placeholder values for all stocks or hiding empty rows.

console_warnings: Radix UI a11y warning: DialogContent requires a DialogTitle in CommandPalette (CommandDialog) and mobile Sheet. Wrap with VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to remove warning. Non-blocking but appears as console.error on every open.

action_items: Add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle inside CommandPalette CommandDialog and the mobile Sheet to silence Radix a11y console.error warnings.
Populate Key Metrics for non-HAL stocks (e.g., BEL, BDL) or gracefully hide empty rows on Stock Detail.
critical_code_review_comments: CommandPalette + mobile Sheet trigger Radix a11y warnings on open due to missing DialogTitle.
StockDetail Peers section uses <Link> but lacks data-testid (e.g., peer-link-{ticker}) — added test bypass via href selector but adding testid would harden tests.
Mock fundamentals only fully populated for HAL — most other tickers show empty Key Metrics.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
context_for_next_testing_agent: All required selectors confirmed working. Market ticker animates BEL/HAL/etc., so when matching ticker text use specific selectors (e.g., a[href='/stock/BEL'] or scoped to Peers panel) to avoid hitting the animated marquee. Fonts load from Fontshare/Google CDN. App is 100% frontend with mock data — no backend tests required.
